answer: An farming party must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the onyx settlement applies the void retroactively. The velvet edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 15 clones produces a signature the zephyr analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
